seo.title: Sacramento Homeless Help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified practical resources for people experiencing homelessness in Sacramento.

page.heading: SACRAMENTO - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger: 911. Local information and referrals: 211. Mental health or substance-use crisis: call or text 988.
page.notice: Availability, eligibility, hours, and capacity can change. Call ahead when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, job, or legal representation.
page.intro: Call 211 and ask for current Sacramento shelter navigation. City-funded shelters usually depend on referral and available capacity.
page.footer: Information can change. Call ahead when possible and report incorrect information through the GitHub link in the footer.

entries.title: Emergency services — 911
entries.description: For immediate danger, fire, a life-threatening medical emergency, or violence.
entries.how_to_access: Give the exact location and explain what is happening.

entries.title: Sacramento 2-1-1
entries.description: Free referrals for shelter, food, health, benefits, and local services; availability is not guaranteed.
entries.how_to_access: Dial 211 and explain your location, household, and urgent needs.

entries.title: City of Sacramento shelter navigation
entries.description: Official city shelter information. Most placements require referral, eligibility, and an available space.
entries.how_to_access: Call 211 or speak with a street-outreach worker.

entries.title: Sacramento Loaves & Fishes — meals
entries.description: Free meals and survival services for adults and families experiencing homelessness. Schedules can change.
entries.how_to_access: Visit the campus and ask staff where meal check-in is taking place.

entries.title: Sacramento Loaves & Fishes
entries.description: Independent charity with meals, hygiene, legal, health, pet, and survival services. Programs have different schedules.
entries.how_to_access: Call or visit and ask which programs are open.

entries.title: Loaves & Fishes — hygiene services
entries.description: Campus programs list restrooms, showers, laundry, and hygiene supplies. Capacity varies.
entries.how_to_access: Arrive early and ask about the day's services.

entries.title: Loaves & Fishes — clothing
entries.description: Clothing and survival supplies may be available; stock is not guaranteed.

entries.title: WellSpace Health
entries.description: Community primary care, behavioral health, and related services. Cost and eligibility vary.
entries.how_to_access: Use the location finder or ask 211 for the closest clinic.

entries.title: Sacramento County benefits
entries.description: Applications for CalFresh, Medi-Cal, CalWORKs, General Assistance, and other programs.
entries.how_to_access: Apply online or contact the county; approval depends on eligibility.

entries.title: Sacramento Works
entries.description: Public job-search, training, career guidance, and employer services.
entries.how_to_access: Find a job center and confirm walk-in hours.

entries.title: Legal Services of Northern California — Sacramento
entries.description: Free civil legal help for eligible low-income people; case acceptance depends on issue and capacity.

entries.title: WEAVE crisis support
entries.description: Confidential support and safety planning for domestic violence, sexual assault, and trafficking.
entries.how_to_access: Call when safe; call 911 for immediate danger.

entries.title: National Call Center for Homeless Veterans
entries.description: Connects veterans who are homeless or at risk with VA services and local resources.
entries.how_to_access: Call and say you are a veteran who is homeless or at risk of losing housing.

entries.title: Loaves & Fishes — pet support
entries.description: Programs may include pet food, kennel, or veterinary-related support; availability varies.
entries.how_to_access: Ask staff about current pet services.
